arc.description: The ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge) benchmark is designed to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of AI models through multiple-choice questions derived from science exams. It includes two subsets: ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge, which vary in difficulty.
arc.name: arc

gsm8k.description: GSM8K (Grade School Math 8K) is a dataset of grade school math problems, designed to evaluate the mathematical reasoning abilities of AI models.
gsm8k.name: gsm8k
gsm8k.prompt_template:
{question}
Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{{}}.

piqa.description: PIQA addresses the challenging task of reasoning about physical commonsense in natural language.
piqa.name: piqa
